name: Clay Studio
summary: Metrics as matte plasticine slabs on a felt table; Pulse's sculpting stick pokes the one lumpy coral tile.
look: Everything is matte clay: chunky slabs with fingerprint grain, clay-coil line charts and fat numerals under warm studio light. Teal, ink and coral clay on an off-white felt table.

components.name: Clay slab
components.role: the base card: 42 px radius, inner highlight + inner shade + warm drop shadow

components.name: Fingerprint grain
components.role: feTurbulence overlay in multiply so every surface looks hand-pressed

components.name: Clay numerals
components.role: Manrope 800 with stacked highlight / ledge shadows; the hero metric

components.name: Clay coil
components.role: a line chart drawn as a rolled worm of teal clay (thick round-cap stroke)

components.name: Sculpting stick
components.role: Pulse's pointer: a wooden tool that pokes the anomaly and leaves a dent

components.name: Press-in button
components.role: the human action; shadows flip inward and it sinks 6 px when chosen

motion.name: Squash & stretch landing
motion.how: scaleY 0.82 → 1.06 → 1, elastic.out(1, .5), 0.5 s; contact frame sits on the downbeat (0.5 s = one beat at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Stop-motion stutter
motion.how: idle wobble of ±1 px / ±0.6° on steps(12) = animated on twos at 24 fps; keeps every slab alive between beats

motion.name: Press-in
motion.how: shadow inset flip + translateY 6 px, power2.out 0.12 s, landing on a snare so the human choice feels physical

story: Hook: a pile of clay dashboard tiles drops onto the table until a coral “38 dashboards open” slab lands. Reveal: the Acme mark squashes onto a plinth on the drop and “Acme Pulse” presses up. Proof: calm metric slabs wobble while the stick pokes the lumpy coral “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231” slab; the human presses “Roll back”. CTA: “You ship. Pulse watches.” with a coral clay “Start free” pill.
adapt: Replace each slab with one of your product's cards (orders, builds, tickets); keep the numbers as real typeset text on the clay so they stay legible, and let only the problem card be lumpy and coral.

references.note: soft, gooey 3D material in the browser

fit.risk: Turns childish if the palette drifts pastel; keep saturated ink/teal/coral and typeset numbers.
